quests.title: Docked on a Moonlit Night

dialogue.t: Ahoy, {NICKNAME}! Great timing. Join us for a round?
Traveler, what a pleasant surprise.

dialogue.sit: What are you two doing here?

dialogue.t: Wait, did you two come together?
This lady decided on a whim that she wanted a little vacation, so we ended up traveling around the area.
But I guess we have different ideas of vacation. We hardly hiked the mountains before we came here to put our feet up. Talk about spoiled.
Come now, no need to hurt anyone's feelings. Besides, I specifically chose this place because I knew how much you like to drink.
But our captain here has seen a lot more of the world, so she's not exactly thrilled with this little tavern.
It'll do. Anyway, this one's on me, okay?
Beidou's paying? Uh, does that include us?
Oh right. Hehe, sorry... guess that's just a habit now.

dialogue.sit: And what can I get for the two lovely ladies?

dialogue.t: I'll have a small Birch Sap, on the sour side.
Uh... I will have a... a large Dusk, please. Thanks!
Well? H—How is it? This silence is making Paimon nervous!
Mmm... The bittersweet taste of nostalgia.
You mean the taste of going from rags to riches? Just what kind of taste is that?
Hehe... It's mainly sour with just a tinge of sweetness, and a lingering aftertaste.
Interesting... Does it taste like starting a little business then discovering that selling fruit isn't very lucrative?
No need to get into the details. Let's leave the past in the past.
Haha, who'd have thought that the dignified Tianquan was once a fruit vendor on the street.
On the other hand, I bet few can tell that I'm from an ordinary fishing village, right?
Not necessarily. If you ask me...
I'd say that Captain Beidou has eyes that can pierce the sea. You're an adventure-seeking pioneer who tames the wind and the waves... Which is clearly indicative of someone who grew up by the sea.
Hey, you're not mocking me, are you?
Come now, it wouldn't do any good to be sarcastic.
I know how fierce you can be with words. It's my treat today, so remember to take it easy on me.
Alright, then I'd like to have a few more.

dialogue.sit: Another drink for the lovely lady?

dialogue.t: Well, you heard the good lady, bartender!
I like where this is going! I'll have another round, too!
Mondstadt's fresh fruit juice is hard to top. I wish I could enjoy some every day.
Are you serious? Don't tell me you're gonna open a Sunsettia trade route now...
Hmm, an interesting proposition.
Wait... Huh, really?
I'm just joking, of course. There's already a whole industry established for that. They don't need me muscling my way in to their business.
Thanks for the drinks today, {NICKNAME}. If you'd ever like a cushy job, I'd enjoy having you as my personal bartender.
You're also welcome aboard the Alcor. The crew loves to drink, you could come feast with us. I promise you'd have a blast.
My, my, Captain Beidou, are you competing with me for talent? That's hardly necessary. You may simply stop by the Jade Chamber whenever you want the Traveler to mix you a drink.
Is it Paimon, or does it sound like they think you work for them?

dialogue.sit: I'll visit you both. I promise.

quests.description: “Do you know that I met a very nice client today? She moved and talked with grace — a very generous buyer, too.” “What did you sell her?” “Trade secret.”
